segments.text: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia's CEO.
Just eleven days after he quit. Here's the whole story in thirty seconds.
November twelfth. He resigns, effective immediately.
November seventeenth. The board says it won't bring him back.
Then President Trump backs his return.
November twenty-third. The board votes unanimously. He's back.

segments.who: NVIDIA BOARD, CITING SENIOR US OFFICIALS
segments.text: The board says American officials see no national security risk.
And the stock jumped twenty-five to thirty percent before the bell.
But the independent investigation is still running.
Like and follow Paravion X for more updates.
